name: LUSTER
recent: Luster Industries 在2026年10月20日公告，董事在闭门期内有买卖公司股票的意向。公司于2026年8月28日发布截至2026年6月30日的季度业绩，营收按季增长2.4%，净利大幅上升。2026年11月17日，公司进行股份回购。
notable: 董事在闭门期内表明有意买卖公司股票。
risks: 董事在闭门期内有买卖公司股票的意向，可能涉及股权变动。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日的季度，营收为6371.1万令吉，按季增长2.4%，按年增长4.4%；净利为271.4万令吉，净利率4.3%，较上一季度的0.1%明显提升，净利按季大幅增长。

recent_en: Luster Industries announced on 20 Oct 2026 that directors intend to deal in the company's shares during the closed period. The company released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 Jun 2026 on 28 Aug 2026, with revenue up 2.4% QoQ and net profit rising sharply. On 17 Nov 2026, the company carried out a shares buyback.
notable_en: Directors indicated intention to deal in company shares during the closed period.
The company conducted a shares buyback.
risks_en: Directors' intention to deal during the closed period may involve changes in shareholdings.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 Jun 2026, revenue was MYR 63.711 million, up 2.4% QoQ and 4.4% YoY; net profit was MYR 2.714 million with a net margin of 4.3%, up significantly from 0.1% in the previous quarter, with net profit rising sharply QoQ.
